verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. The hypothesis that Q has no nonzero fixed vector makes I-Q invertible. Orthogonality then yields A+A^{𝐓}=I for A=(I-Q)^{-1}, which gives u^{𝐓}Au=1/2. The constructed nonzero vector w=Au consequently satisfies HQw=w. All hypotheses are used, and there are no external references or hard-prohibition violations.
